note: Eight studio posters and lecture slides/diagrams for /teaching/, WebP q88 (PIL), max 2000 px wide. Posters are cropped above the organiser by-line; slides with an organiser logo corner had that corner blanked and the faint light-grey organiser watermark mapped to white (near-neutral pixels lighter than 185 only). No student work, photos of people or institution names are included. Revision: text-heavy lecture slides were converted to web text and their images removed (listed under delete); kept the 8 posters and one low-text diagram.
